<thought>Based on the most intense ESI‑MS peak at m/z 141.115 Da, the likely ion is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The formula C₈H₁₂O₂ matches this mass closely (140.0837 Da) and is the simplest composition consistent with the data, so it is taken as the molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H12O2</final_answer>
